_about: IU Bloomington's degree-granting schools, named exactly as https://bloomington.iu.edu/academics/schools/index.html lists them (retrieved 2026-11-09; the page says '16 degree-granting schools and colleges, along with ... the Hutton Honors College').

apiNames are the names the same schools carry in IU's degree finder data (raw/iu_degrees_bloomington.json). A program listed under 'Graduate School' or 'University Graduate School' together with another school belongs to that other school (its academic home); only a program listed under the graduate school alone belongs to Graduate School Bloomington.

The College's three schools (Eskenazi, Hamilton Lugar, The Media School) are part of the College of Arts and Sciences. IU lists most of their programs under both the College and the school, and each program counts for every school it is listed under.

excluded.reason: Listed on the schools page as a specialized honors program, not one of the 16 degree-granting schools; it offers no degree of its own.
